name: @jdsalasc/solvejs-xlsx
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript XLSX reader and writer built from scratch, with declarative JSX components, rich styling, formulas, images, CSV and a metadata-rich reader.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:tsx
scripts.test:tsx: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --jsx react-jsx --jsxImportSource @jdsalasc/solvejs-xlsx test/fixtures/jsx-auto.tsx && tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --jsx react-jsxdev --jsxImportSource @jdsalasc/solvejs-xlsx test/fixtures/jsx-dev.tsx

author: jdsalasc
